vocabulary.meaning_en: in a hopeful way, believing things will go well
vocabulary.example: Listen optimistically: believe you can understand.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the way you think or feel at a certain time
vocabulary.example: Start the test in a good frame of mind.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the feeling that you can do something well
vocabulary.example: You need more confidence when you speak.
Listening for ideas primes your brain for English.

vocabulary.meaning_en: having experience and knowledge and making good decisions
vocabulary.example: My grandfather is a wise man.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (noun) the part of a gun you pull; (verb) to cause a sudden feeling or reaction
to be ready to listen to new ideas without judging quickly
vocabulary.example: Keep an open mind and listen to the end.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the information or ideas in something
vocabulary.note_en: Stress on the first part: CONtent.
vocabulary.example: Judge the content, not the delivery.
His delivery is fast, but his ideas are good.

vocabulary.meaning_en: using every chance to get a benefit
vocabulary.example: Be opportunistic: use every chance to practise listening.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a chance to do something good
vocabulary.example: Every conversation is an opportunity to learn.
What is the benefit for me?

fine_lines.title: listen for words vs listen for ideas
fine_lines.explanation_ar: إذا حاولت سماع كل كلمة ستفوتك أشياء كثيرة وتشعر بالإحباط. استمع للفكرة العامة: أعطِ عقلك مهمة (ما الفكرة؟) فيركّز أكثر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: If you try to hear every word, you will miss a lot and feel frustrated. Listen for the general idea: give your brain a job (What's the idea?) and it focuses better.

examples.sentence: "I need to hear every word!" (you get lost)
"What is this person trying to tell me?" (you understand more)

fine_lines.title: content vs delivery
fine_lines.explanation_ar: content = المعلومات والأفكار. delivery = طريقة الكلام (سريع، بطيء). احكم على المحتوى لا على طريقة الإلقاء.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Content = the information and ideas. Delivery = the way someone speaks (fast, slow). Judge the content, not the delivery.

examples.sentence: The content of his talk was very useful.
His delivery was too fast for me.

expressions.example: Before you listen, ask: what's in it for me?

expressions.meaning_en: Give your mind a clear task so it focuses.
expressions.example: Give your brain a job: find the main idea.
Oh, now I get the idea. Thanks!

expressions.phrase: There is no magic. It's work.
expressions.meaning_ar: لا يوجد سحر، إنه عمل واجتهاد.
expressions.example: Want to understand English fast? There is no magic. It's work.
Keep an open mind until the speaker finishes.

grammar.title: Six tips in the imperative
grammar.explanation_ar: النصائح تُقال بصيغة الأمر: المصدر بدون فاعل. (1) Listen optimistically. (2) Listen for ideas, not exact words. (3) Listen longer. (4) Keep an open mind. (5) Judge content, not delivery. (6) Be opportunistic.
grammar.explanation_en: Tips are given in the imperative: base verb, no subject. (1) Listen optimistically. (2) Listen for ideas, not exact words. (3) Listen longer. (4) Keep an open mind. (5) Judge content, not delivery. (6) Be opportunistic.

grammar.title: Adjective → adverb with -ly
grammar.explanation_ar: الصفة تصف الاسم، والظرف يصف الفعل. نضيف ly للصفة: optimistic → optimistically، quick → quickly، careful → carefully.
grammar.explanation_en: An adjective describes a noun; an adverb describes a verb. Add -ly: optimistic → optimistically, quick → quickly, careful → carefully.

grammar.title: listen for vs listen to
grammar.explanation_ar: listen to + شخص/صوت: تستمع إليه. listen for + شيء: تستمع منتظرًا أن تلتقط شيئًا محددًا (فكرة، اسم).
grammar.explanation_en: Listen to + person/sound: pay attention to it. Listen for + something: listen in order to catch something (an idea, a name).

questions.question: What is the best way to start understanding a native speaker?
"Judge content, not delivery" means ___.
choices: focus on the information, not the speaking style
questions.explanation_ar: ركّز على المعلومات لا على طريقة الكلام.
questions.explanation_en: Focus on the information, not the style.

questions.question: "Listen ___." (in a hopeful way)
questions.explanation_en: An adverb describes the verb: optimistically.

questions.question: What does WIIFM mean?
choices: Who is in it with me?

questions.question: "Keep an open mind" means ___.
choices: be ready to hear new ideas without judging quickly
questions.explanation_en: Be ready to hear new ideas.

questions.question: A "trigger" in this lesson is something that ___.
choices: is a kind of word list

questions.question: Why do wise people listen longer?
choices: To hear everything and make good decisions.
questions.explanation_ar: ليسمعوا كل شيء ويتخذوا قرارات جيدة.
questions.explanation_en: To hear everything and decide well.

questions.question: "Listen ___ the main idea." (to catch something)
questions.explanation_en: Listen for = listen to catch something.
